connector.name: SQLBot MCP Proxy
connector.registryDescription: MCP server proxy for SQLBot Text-to-SQL queries and report generation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image sqlbot-mcp-proxy:0.1.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wenrou21 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SQLBOT_MCP_PROXY_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the SQLBot service, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000.

env.name: SQLBOT_MCP_PROXY_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: SQLBot API access key. If omitted, the proxy can try FEISHU_ASK_ACCESS_KEY or read from the configured Docker container.

env.name: SQLBOT_MCP_PROXY_SECRET_KEY
env.description: SQLBot API secret key. If omitted, the proxy can try FEISHU_ASK_SECRET_KEY or read from the configured Docker container.

env.name: SQLBOT_MCP_PROXY_DOCKER_CONTAINER
env.description: Optional Docker container name used when reading FEISHU_ASK_ACCESS_KEY and FEISHU_ASK_SECRET_KEY from a running SQLBot container.
